topics.label: Introduction to cancer therapy and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the introductory framing and intended learning outcomes for the lecture.

topics.label: Conventional cancer therapies and cytotoxic resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss standard therapeutic modalities including surgery, radiotherapy, and cytotoxic chemotherapy alongside their associated systemic toxicities and efflux-mediated drug resistance.

topics.label: Targeting intrinsic cancer cell vulnerabilities and defects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore therapeutic strategies that exploit intrinsic tumor vulnerabilities such as hormone receptor dependence, cell cycle checkpoint deficiencies, and DNA repair defects through synthetic lethality.

topics.label: Targeted kinase inhibitors and mechanisms of resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the rationale, structural mechanism, and emergence of drug resistance and addiction associated with small-molecule kinase inhibitors targeting oncogenic driver proteins.

topics.label: Antibody-based targeted therapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the design and cytotoxic mechanisms of therapeutic monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates directed against tumor cell-surface markers.

topics.label: Cancer immunotherapy and cellular therapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover the principles of tumor immune surveillance and the development of immunotherapies designed to harness or engineer T cells against cancer.

topics.label: Historical progress, future directions, and therapeutic dilemmas
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics assess long-term trends in cancer survival while addressing the broader clinical challenges, preventative strategies, and ethical dilemmas involved in evolving cancer management.
